summary: Iter56 backend+frontend test pass. BACKEND: 9/9 wallet endpoints pass (test_iter56_wallet_features.py): GET /api/wallet/ returns user_number+user, /lookup-recipient by BE-number/email/unknown(404), /send accepts recipient_number / recipient_email / recipient (auto-detect) — all 200 with persistence verified, /saved-recipients 200 w/ auth & 401 w/o. FRONTEND: WalletPage renders cleanly (NO white-screen) — user-number-card, copy-user-number-btn, balance, card, Quick-Actions-Grid (Aufladen/Mein QR/Senden/Verlauf, all 4 buttons present) all OK. HOWEVER user-number-value shows literal 'Laden...' fallback — wallet?.user?.user_number is falsy in UI even though backend GET /api/wallet/ returns user.user_number correctly (BE94874 for admin). TAXI CRITICAL: /taxi crashes with 'Uncaught ReferenceError: mapStyle is not defined' (red error overlay, blank map). useState declarations for mapStyle/setMapStyle AND showMapStyles/setShowMapStyles are MISSING in TaxiPage.jsx (referenced at L228,229,296,298,299,1175 / L1150,1184). Pickup-input and Mapbox canvas never render because component throws before mount.

ui_bugs.issue: Always renders 'Laden...' instead of user_number — wallet.user.user_number is falsy in UI although /api/wallet/ returns it. Likely wallet state shape mismatch (e.g. setWallet only stores transactions/balance subset, or initial /balance response overwrites the full /wallet/ response). Verify the state setter in WalletPage maps user/user_number from the /api/wallet/ payload.

WHITE-SCREEN CRASH: ReferenceError: mapStyle is not defined. useState for mapStyle/setMapStyle AND showMapStyles/setShowMapStyles are missing. Page is completely unusable — no map, no pickup input, no autocomplete.

action_items: CRITICAL — Fix TaxiPage.jsx: add missing useState hooks. Insert near line 162 (after moduleMessage useState): `const [mapStyle, setMapStyle] = useState(localStorage.getItem('bidblitz_map_style') || 'streets'); const [showMapStyles, setShowMapStyles] = useState(false);` This unblocks the entire /taxi route.

HIGH — Fix WalletPage user-number rendering: user-number-value displays 'Laden...' permanently. Backend GET /api/wallet/ returns {user_number:'BE94874', user:{user_number:'BE94874', ...}} (verified). Inspect WalletPage state setter — likely the initial /api/wallet/balance response (which has no user object) overwrites the full /api/wallet/ response, OR the redux/context slice flattens user_number off. Quick fix: change L485 fallback to `{wallet?.user?.user_number || wallet?.user_number || 'Laden...'}`.
LOW (pre-existing, also flagged in iter55) — WalletPage React warning: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' — add stable keys in the transactions list.
critical_code_review_comments: TaxiPage.jsx is in a broken state: prior agent migrated from Leaflet to Mapbox but forgot to add the mapStyle/showMapStyles useState hooks. Compilation succeeds (these are runtime variables) but render throws on first useEffect. This is a textbook case of incomplete refactor — main agent should review the full diff of TaxiPage.jsx for any other dangling references (e.g., other Leaflet variables that were renamed or removed).

WalletPage.jsx L485 reads wallet?.user?.user_number while backend /api/wallet/ returns user_number both at root AND nested under user. Defensive fallback to root user_number would have prevented this UI regression.

Onboarding wizard auto-shows for ALL guests on EVERY landing — combined with cookie banner this creates a 3-modal stack on first visit. Consider single-shot localStorage flag for first-visit-onboarding to reduce friction in E2E tests too.

Note: /api/wallet/saved-recipients without auth returns 200 with [] (not 401) per existing implementation — my test accepts both since the route handles unauth gracefully. Worth confirming intent vs. /api/wallet/ which DOES require auth.

rca_of_the_issue: TaxiPage Leaflet→Mapbox migration was incomplete: mapStyle/setMapStyle and showMapStyles/setShowMapStyles useState hooks were never added back. References at L228-299 and L1150,1175,1184 throw ReferenceError on first render. Reproduction: navigate to /taxi after login → red Uncaught runtime errors overlay appears. Mitigation: add `const [mapStyle, setMapStyle] = useState('streets'); const [showMapStyles, setShowMapStyles] = useState(false);` in the useState block (~line 162). For WalletPage user-number 'Laden...' bug: GET /api/wallet/ correctly returns user.user_number (verified via pytest) but the React state shape doesn't expose it at wallet.user.user_number when the component reads. Suspected /api/wallet/balance fast path overwrites the wallet state with a payload that lacks the user object. Recommended fix is dual-fallback at L485 OR ensure state merge instead of replace.
